clusterCount.description: Quantity of MongoDB Cloud clusters deployed in this project.

created.description: Date and time when MongoDB Cloud created this project. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

id.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the MongoDB Cloud project.

links.description: List of one or more Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) that point to API sub-resources, related API resources, or both. RFC 5988 outlines these relationships.

name.description: Human-readable label that identifies the project included in the MongoDB Cloud organization.

orgId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the MongoDB Cloud organization to which the project belongs.

regionUsageRestrictions.description:
Applies to Atlas for Government only.

In Commercial Atlas, this field will be rejected in requests and missing in responses.

This field sets restrictions on available regions in the project.

`COMMERCIAL_FEDRAMP_REGIONS_ONLY`: Only allows deployments in FedRAMP Moderate regions.

`GOV_REGIONS_ONLY`: Only allows deployments in GovCloud regions.

tags.description: List that contains key-value pairs between 1 to 255 characters in length for tagging and categorizing the project.

withDefaultAlertsSettings.description: Flag that indicates whether to create the project with default alert settings.

href.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that points another API resource to which this response has some relationship. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.

rel.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that defines the semantic relationship between this resource and another API resource. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.

ResourceTag.description: Key-value pair that tags and categorizes a MongoDB Cloud organization, project, or cluster. For example, `environment : production`.

key.description: Constant that defines the set of the tag. For example, `environment` in the `environment : production` tag.

value.description: Variable that belongs to the set of the tag. For example, `production` in the `environment : production` tag.

ResourceTag.title: Resource Tag
